venues.long: A traditional nautical lounge for single-malt Scotch, small-batch bourbon and classic pre-dinner cocktails.

venues.title: Lotus Spa
venues.short: Massages, facials, acupuncture and medi-spa treatments, run with OneSpaWorld.
venues.long: The ship’s wellness sanctuary: bamboo and hot-stone massages, ELEMIS Pro-Collagen facials, seaweed wraps, acupuncture and physician-administered medi-spa services. On embarkation day the spa opens with guided tours.

venues.title: Lotus Salon and Barber
venues.short: Hair, nails, barber shaves and teeth whitening.
venues.long: Hair styling, keratin treatments, barber shaves, manicures, pedicures and teeth whitening, next to the Lotus Spa. Formal-night updos and blowouts book up early.

venues.title: The Enclave Thermal Suite
venues.short: A paid-access hydrotherapy and thermal sanctuary with a Himalayan Salt Room.
venues.long: A warm hydrotherapy pool with cascading rain showers and air jets, heated ceramic loungers, a Turkish hammam, an aromatic herbal steam room, a dry Finnish sauna and, on Sun Princess, a Himalayan Salt Room and sensory experience showers. A thermal pass is about $149 to $199 a week, or a session can be booked here.

venues.title: Sanctuary Club
venues.short: The adults-only sun deck for Sanctuary Collection guests, with an infinity pool and private bar.
venues.long: Reserved for Sanctuary Collection suite and stateroom guests: an infinity pool, a private bar and live DJ chill sessions on the top deck. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Arena
venues.short: The transformable theatre-in-the-round for the headline production shows.
venues.long: Movable seating banks and a rotating central stage, with surround sound, LED backdrops and aerial rigging. It hosts Viva La Música, Vallora: A Pirate Quest, Stage Struck and Fiera!, as well as guest comedians and vocalists.
accessibility: Wheelchair spaces on both sides of the middle block; ask an usher

venues.title: The Dome
venues.short: A glass dome that is a pool deck by day and an acrobatic theatre by night.
venues.long: A glass-roofed dome with a waterfall pool and tiered lounge seating. At night the pool is covered to make a stage for the Cirque Éloize productions Blue, Come Fly Away and ArtBeat, aerialists and late-night DJ parties.

venues.title: The Piazza
venues.short: The three-deck glass atrium for live music, street performers and pop-up parties.
venues.long: A glass sphere looking out to sea, around a central stage and an LED screen. From morning until midnight there are string quartets, acoustic duos, classical pianists, aerial pop-up acts, dance classes and the Captain’s Champagne Waterfall.
accessibility: Each level has a lift to the others

venues.title: Princess Live!
venues.short: A TV-studio lounge for game shows, trivia and late-night comedy.
venues.long: Styled like a television soundstage, with camera rigs and banquette seating. By day it has trivia, cooking demonstrations and Wake Show tapings; at night it is a comedy club and game-show arena.

venues.title: O’Malley’s live music
venues.short: Nightly live folk and acoustic rock in the Irish pub.
venues.long: Resident soloists and duos play Celtic classics, sing-alongs and pub rock every evening, with Irish whiskey tastings. Food and drink are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Wheelhouse live music
venues.short: Piano, jazz combos and ballroom dancing in the nautical lounge.
venues.long: A refined lounge of wood panelling and brass ship models. Afternoon board games give way to resident pianists, jazz combos and slow dancing in the evening. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: SeaView and Wake View Terraces
venues.short: The outdoor decks for sailaway parties, deck bands and Movies Under the Stars.
venues.long: The forward SeaView Terrace has the giant LED screen and the main pool stage; the aft Wake View Terrace has an infinity pool and a sunset bar. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Spellbound by Magic Castle
venues.short: A speakeasy parlour of close-up magic and theatrical cocktails, by ticket.
venues.long: Made with Hollywood’s Magic Castle, behind an unmarked door: secret rooms, smoking cocktails in the Music Room and a 30-seat velvet theatre for illusionists. Seatings are ticketed and small.

venues.title: Princess Casino
venues.short: The largest casino in the fleet, closed in port.
venues.long: Over 9,000 square feet with more than 200 video slots, progressive jackpots and 13 live tables, including blackjack, craps, roulette, three-card poker, Ultimate Texas Hold’em and baccarat. A separate smoke-free annex has its own bar. Slot machines, live table games and electronic roulette, paid with your Medallion through ticket-in, ticket-out. It is run in international waters, so it is closed in port and opens 30 to 45 minutes after the ship sails.

venues.title: Lotus Fitness Center
venues.short: A 24-hour ocean-view gym with Precor cardio and strength equipment.
venues.long: Overlooking the main Lido pool deck through floor-to-ceiling windows, this complimentary gym has Precor treadmills with personal screens, ellipticals, adaptive motion trainers, bikes, free weights, kettlebells, a Smith machine and a Total Gym Elevate core station. The doors stay unlocked all day and night, and fitness staff are on duty from 7 am to 8 pm.

venues.title: Fitness and Wellness Studios
venues.short: Two studios next to the gym for group classes and recovery.
venues.long: The Fitness Studio hosts Xponential Fitness classes (Pure Barre, YogaSix, Club Pilates, CycleBar and StretchLab) during scheduled blocks. The Wellness Studio next door has zero-gravity chairs, personal training and metabolic assessments by appointment. Closed overnight outside scheduled sessions.

venues.title: SkyDeck Sport Court and Track
venues.short: An open-air multi-sport court inside an elevated running track.
venues.long: A 240-metre (790-foot) jogging track, where about 6.7 laps make a mile, circles a court set up for basketball, pickleball, tennis, ping pong and shuffleboard. The track can be walked at any hour, but running and court play stop at 8 pm so the noise does not carry to the decks below.

venues.title: The Dome and Lido Pools
venues.short: Glass-enclosed and open-air pools for lap swimming and morning yoga.
venues.long: The main Lido pools open at 6 am and close at 10 pm; The Dome is open from 7 am to 11 pm. Swim tethers for stationary endurance swimming can be checked out during pool hours, and select morning YogaSix sessions are held in The Dome before the lounge fills. The pools close overnight for netting and maintenance.

venues.title: The Shops of Princess
venues.short: The flagship logo and souvenir store: apparel, ship models, Stanley plush and travel essentials.
venues.long: Along the Deck 7 Piazza promenade, with exclusive Sun Princess and Sphere-class merchandise, collectible die-cast ship models, Stanley the Bear plush toys, destination hoodies and caps, and the things you forgot: sunscreen, over-the-counter medicines, adapters and snacks. Duty and tax free in international waters.

venues.title: The Beauty and Fragrance Studio
venues.short: An open-concept cosmetics and perfumery hall with luxury skincare and signature scents.
venues.long: Styled like a department-store beauty floor, with counters for Chanel, Dior, Lancôme, Estée Lauder, Clinique and Jo Malone, and complimentary mini-makeovers, skincare consultations and fragrance profiling.

venues.title: Fine Timepieces and Luxury Horology Salon
venues.short: A watch gallery of Swiss horology and certified pre-owned pieces.
venues.long: On the Deck 8 gallery overlooking the Piazza, with brand corners for TAG Heuer, Breitling, Longines, Tissot, Rado and Hamilton, and a vault of certified pre-owned Rolex and Cartier.

venues.title: Effy Fine Jewelry Boutique
venues.short: A fine jewelry salon for coloured gemstones, diamonds and exclusive Princess collections.
venues.long: Private viewing salons, custom ring settings, tanzanite and emerald suites, and complimentary daily charm-bracelet giveaways during promotional hours.

venues.title: Luxury Fashion and Accessories Gallery
venues.short: Designer handbags, resort wear, eyewear and Italian leather goods.
venues.long: Shop-in-shops including a Lacoste “Le Club” store, a Swarovski crystal gallery, a Ray-Ban and Maui Jim sunglass bar and certified pre-owned luxury handbags, for resort and formal-night styling.

venues.title: Spirits, Wine and Tobacco Duty-Free Market
venues.short: Single malts, small-batch bourbons, champagne and Swiss chocolates.
venues.long: Travel-exclusive litre bottles of spirits, vintage champagnes, regional wines and chocolates from Godiva, Toblerone and Lindt. Alcohol bought to take home is held by the ship and delivered to your stateroom on the final evening.
features: Alcohol delivered on the last evening

venues.title: Fine Arts Gallery and Photo Studio
venues.short: Digital photo kiosks and a walk-through gallery of Romero Britto, Thomas Kinkade and Peter Max.
venues.long: Facial-recognition photo stations linked to your OceanMedallion, beside a gallery of framed lithographs, sculptures and original paintings for direct purchase or live auction. The displays stay open all day and night; the desk is staffed 9 am to 10 pm at sea and from 5 pm after a port.

venues.title: Piazza Pop-Up Tables
venues.short: Flash sales, the Inch of Gold chain bar and visiting artisans on the Piazza floor.
venues.long: $10 to $20 grab-and-go deals on pashminas, handbags, fashion watches and T-shirts, the Inch of Gold and Inch of Silver custom chain bar, and on some itineraries a visiting local artisan. Folding tables set up for the day. They follow the shops’ rules, so they are closed alongside and open after the ship sails.

venues.title: Poolside Pop-Up Market
venues.short: Sunglasses, sun hats, cover-ups and logo apparel by the main pool.
venues.long: An outdoor market set up on sea days, and for a short while after sailaway, weather permitting, by the SeaView Terrace.

venues.title: Signature Lounge Card and Game Tables
venues.short: Quiet tables stocked with cards, mahjong sets, board games and chess.
venues.long: A calm corner of the Signature Lounge set aside for bridge, mahjong, cribbage, Scrabble, chess and Catan. The tables are unstaffed and open all day; on sea days a bridge director and the cruise staff host lessons and meet-ups here.

venues.title: Princess Arena Daytime Talks
venues.short: Discovery at SEA lectures, port talks and the captain’s question-and-answer panel.
venues.long: The main show lounge by day: Discovery at SEA talks by naturalists, historians and marine biologists, port and shopping presentations, the captain’s panel and the disembarkation talk. Talks are replayed on the stateroom TV.

venues.title: The Conservatory Workshops
venues.short: Hands-on crafts, art and music lessons with supplies provided.
venues.long: Staff hand out the supplies for origami, paper flowers, watercolor postcards and, on Pacific voyages, ribbon leis. Ukuleles are loaned for the lessons, and choir rehearsals build to a last-day showcase. Supplies are limited, so come early.

venues.title: Hearts & Minds Chapel and Meeting Rooms
venues.short: Faith services, fellowship and hosted meet-ups for shared interests.
venues.long: A quiet chapel and meeting rooms for interdenominational devotionals, Catholic Mass when a priest is aboard, interfaith reflection and the Shabbat service. The same rooms host the solo travellers, veterans, LGBTQ+ and Friends of Bill W. gatherings. All are welcome and nothing is charged.

venues.title: Camp Discovery Youth Centre
venues.short: Supervised play, science and movie nights for ages 3 to 12.
venues.long: Three age groups: The Treehouse (ages 3 to 7), The Lodge (8 to 12) and The Beach House (13 to 17). Counselors run Discovery at SEA science, scavenger hunts and games, and port-day supervised play for children whose parents are ashore. Register at the centre on embarkation day or in the app.

venues.title: The Beach House Teen Centre
venues.short: A hangout for ages 13 to 17 with game tournaments and scavenger hunts.
venues.long: Video game tournaments, hunts around the ship and a late-evening music night for teens. The Beach House is part of Camp Discovery, so the same registration applies.

venues.title: Open Decks and Viewing Areas
venues.short: The bow, promenade and upper decks for harbor arrivals, scenic cruising and stargazing.
venues.long: The forward observation decks and railings where guests gather for harbor pilot and docking, Glacier Bay or canal commentary and Discovery at SEA stargazing. Weather permitting; dress warmly.

venues.title: OceanFront Tech Desk
venues.short: Help with MedallionNet Wi-Fi, the Princess app, boarding passes and your Medallion.
venues.long: The staffed tech desk sets up MedallionNet Wi-Fi, helps with the Princess app and photos, prints airline boarding passes, and on the last day helps with Medallion keepsakes and folio questions. Opening hours follow the day: the desk reopens after sailaway on port days.

venues.title: Lotus Spa
venues.short: Massages, facials, acupuncture and medi-spa treatments, run with OneSpaWorld.
venues.long: The ship’s wellness sanctuary: bamboo and hot-stone massages, ELEMIS Pro-Collagen facials, seaweed wraps, acupuncture and physician-administered medi-spa services. On embarkation day the spa opens with guided tours.

venues.title: Lotus Salon and Barber
venues.short: Hair, nails, barber shaves and teeth whitening.
venues.long: Hair styling, keratin treatments, barber shaves, manicures, pedicures and teeth whitening, next to the Lotus Spa. Formal-night updos and blowouts book up early.

venues.title: The Enclave Thermal Suite
venues.short: A paid-access hydrotherapy and thermal sanctuary.
venues.long: A warm hydrotherapy pool with cascading rain showers and air jets, heated ceramic loungers, a Turkish hammam, an aromatic herbal steam room and a dry Finnish sauna. A thermal pass is about $149 to $199 a week, or a session can be booked here.

venues.title: The Sanctuary
venues.short: An adults-only (18+) open-air retreat with teak loungers and steward service.
venues.long: A tranquil adults-only retreat with thick-cushioned teak loungers, chilled face towels, misters and light healthy fare, with outdoor massage cabanas. Half a day is $20 and a full day $40. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Theater
venues.short: The two-deck Broadway-style theatre for production shows and headliners.
venues.long: Tiered seating with clear sightlines, a live showband and digital projection mapping. It headlines Rock Opera, 5-SKIES and Spotlight Bar alongside touring vocalists and illusionists.
accessibility: Wheelchair spaces at the back and sides; ask an usher

venues.title: Take Five
venues.short: The only dedicated jazz theatre at sea, with a live trio each night.
venues.long: A mid-century Harlem jazz club of exposed brick and neon. By day there are salsa lessons and acoustic sessions; at night a resident trio plays themed sets, with craft cocktails.

venues.title: Vista Lounge
venues.short: The aft cabaret lounge for comedians, party bands, bingo and theme parties.
venues.long: A wrap-around-window lounge with a central dance floor. Daytime art auctions and bingo give way to stand-up, tribute bands and 70s and 80s disco nights.

venues.title: Princess Live! and Café
venues.short: A TV-studio venue for trivia, culinary shows, game shows and late-night comedy.
venues.long: A studio audience with audience keypads and cameras feeding the cabin TVs, and its own espresso and cocktail bar. Daily trivia, talent auditions and adult comedy at night.

venues.title: The Piazza
venues.short: The three-deck marble atrium with continuous live music and gala parties.
venues.long: A European town square at sea. String ensembles, ballroom demonstrations, fruit-carving demonstrations and the Captain’s Champagne Waterfall, from morning to night.
accessibility: Each level has a lift to the others

venues.title: Top Deck Pool and Movies Under the Stars
venues.short: The twin-pool lido deck with an outdoor LED cinema screen and stage.
venues.long: By day, live party bands, poolside games and ice carving; by night, blankets and popcorn for the big screen, between Water and Light fountain shows. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Crooners
venues.short: The piano martini lounge for requests and sing-alongs.
venues.long: Looking over the Piazza, with a Rat Pack soundtrack and a piano entertainer taking requests late into the night. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Princess Casino
venues.short: Slots and table games, closed in port.
venues.long: The forward casino has 150 to 180 slots, live table pits and automated Texas Hold’em tables, and is smoke-free on most sailings. Slot machines, live table games and electronic roulette, paid with your Medallion through ticket-in, ticket-out. It is run in international waters, so it is closed in port and opens 30 to 45 minutes after the ship sails.

venues.title: Fitness Center
venues.short: A large aft-facing gym with cardio machines and weight stations, open 24 hours.
venues.long: At the rear of the Sun Deck, this complimentary gym has treadmills, ellipticals, stationary bikes, resistance machines and a free-weight area. The doors stay unlocked all day and night, and the staffed desk is open from 7 am to 7:30 pm.

venues.title: Aerobics Studio
venues.short: The enclosed group exercise room for cycling, barre, yoga and stretching.
venues.long: Open during staffed hours for indoor cycling (CycleBar), Pure Barre, YogaSix and StretchLab sessions, next to the gym.

venues.title: Centre Court and Jogging Track
venues.short: A fenced rooftop court surrounded by an outdoor walking and running loop.
venues.long: On the Sports Deck above the aft gym, Centre Court hosts pick-up games and tournaments for basketball, pickleball, volleyball, tennis and badminton. Walkers can use the loop at any hour; running and ball games stop at 8 pm so the cabins on Deck 17 are not disturbed.

venues.title: The Greens
venues.short: A rooftop miniature golf putting green for gentle, low-impact play.
venues.long: The highest aft deck, overlooking the sports court. Putters and balls are on loan from the Sports Desk until dusk, and there are scheduled putting competitions.

venues.title: Sky Pool and Fountain Pool
venues.short: The two Lido pools, open early for lap swimming and used for poolside fitness.
venues.long: The Sky Pool and the Fountain Pool sit mid-ship on the Lido deck. Open lap swimming runs in the middle of the day on port days, and poolside dance and Zumba fitness take over a pool deck on sea days. Pools close at 10 pm.

venues.title: Calypso Cove
venues.short: Convenience, duty-free liquor, snacks and Princess logo souvenirs.
venues.long: Off the Piazza floor: duty-free spirits, travel-size toiletries, over-the-counter remedies, chocolates, Princess T-shirts and magnets.

venues.title: Essence
venues.short: Duty-free fragrance, skincare and luxury cosmetics.
venues.long: Dior, Chanel, Guerlain, Clinique and Estée Lauder at up to 25 to 30 percent off U.S. mainland prices, with complimentary skin diagnostics from the beauty specialists.

venues.title: Facets
venues.short: Fine jewelry and Swiss watches, including Effy, Tissot and Longines.
venues.long: A glass-fronted salon of diamond solitaires, coloured gemstones and Swiss watches, hosting nightly trunk shows and gemstone seminars.

venues.title: Meridian Bay
venues.short: Fashion jewelry, sunglasses, handbags and evening accessories.
venues.long: On the upper Piazza gallery: Swarovski crystal jewelry, Brighton handbags and charms, designer sunglasses, pashminas and evening clutches.

venues.title: Limelight Fashion Boutique
venues.short: Resort wear, smart-casual cruise clothes and destination outerwear.
venues.long: Easy-to-pack linen shirts and swimwear and, on Northern Europe or Alaska sailings, weatherproof jackets, fleeces and cashmere scarves.

venues.title: Photo and Fine Arts Galleries
venues.short: Portrait studios, digital photo galleries and Park West fine art.
venues.long: Portrait studios, a digital photo gallery and Park West exhibitions. The displays stay open all day and night; the desk is staffed 9 am to 10 pm at sea and from 5 pm after a port.

venues.title: Piazza Pop-Up Tables
venues.short: Flash sales, the Inch of Gold chain bar and visiting artisans on the Piazza floor.
venues.long: $10 to $20 deals on watches, shawls, evening bags and costume jewelry, the Inch of Gold chain bar, and on some itineraries a visiting local artisan. Folding tables set up for the day. They follow the shops’ rules, so they are closed alongside and open after the ship sails.

venues.title: Top Deck Pool Pop-Up Market
venues.short: Sunglasses, cover-ups, logo tees, hats and beach bags by the pool.
venues.long: An outdoor market set up on sea days, and for a short while after sailaway, weather permitting.

venues.title: Vista Lounge Card Corner
venues.short: Quiet daytime tables for bridge, mahjong, board games and chess.
venues.long: A corner of the Vista Lounge, and on some days the Crown Grill Bar, stocked with cards, mahjong sets, Scrabble, chess and Catan. The tables are unstaffed and open all day; on sea days a bridge director and the cruise staff host lessons and meet-ups.

venues.title: Princess Theater Daytime Talks
venues.short: Discovery at SEA lectures, port talks and the captain’s question-and-answer panel.
venues.long: The main theater by day: Discovery at SEA talks by naturalists, historians and marine biologists, port and shopping presentations, the captain’s panel and the disembarkation talk. Talks are replayed on the stateroom TV.

venues.title: Horizon Court Activity Corner
venues.short: Hands-on crafts, art and music lessons with supplies provided.
venues.long: Staff hand out the supplies for origami, paper flowers, watercolor postcards and, on Pacific voyages, ribbon leis. Ukuleles are loaned for the lessons, and choir rehearsals build to a last-day showcase. Supplies are limited, so come early.

venues.title: Hearts & Minds Chapel and Meeting Rooms
venues.short: Faith services, fellowship and hosted meet-ups for shared interests.
venues.long: A quiet chapel and meeting rooms for interdenominational devotionals, Catholic Mass when a priest is aboard, interfaith reflection and the Shabbat service. The same rooms host the solo travellers, veterans, LGBTQ+ and Friends of Bill W. gatherings. All are welcome and nothing is charged.

venues.title: Camp Discovery Youth Centre
venues.short: Supervised play, science and movie nights for ages 3 to 12.
venues.long: Three age groups: The Treehouse (ages 3 to 7), The Lodge (8 to 12) and The Beach House (13 to 17). Counselors run Discovery at SEA science, scavenger hunts and games, and port-day supervised play for children whose parents are ashore. Register at the centre on embarkation day or in the app.

venues.title: The Beach House Teen Centre
venues.short: A hangout for ages 13 to 17 with game tournaments and scavenger hunts.
venues.long: Video game tournaments, hunts around the ship and a late-evening music night for teens. The Beach House is part of Camp Discovery, so the same registration applies.

venues.title: Open Decks and Viewing Areas
venues.short: The bow, promenade and upper decks for harbor arrivals, scenic cruising and stargazing.
venues.long: The forward observation decks and railings where guests gather for harbor pilot and docking, Glacier Bay or fjord commentary and Discovery at SEA stargazing. Weather permitting; dress warmly.

venues.title: OceanFront Tech Desk
venues.short: Help with MedallionNet Wi-Fi, the Princess app, boarding passes and your Medallion.
venues.long: The staffed tech desk sets up MedallionNet Wi-Fi, helps with the Princess app and photos, prints airline boarding passes, and on the last day helps with Medallion keepsakes and folio questions. Opening hours follow the day: the desk reopens after sailaway on port days.

venues.title: Lotus Spa
venues.short: Massages, facials, acupuncture and medi-spa treatments, run with OneSpaWorld.
venues.long: The ship’s wellness sanctuary: bamboo and hot-stone massages, ELEMIS Pro-Collagen facials, seaweed wraps, acupuncture and physician-administered medi-spa services. On embarkation day the spa opens with guided tours.

venues.title: Lotus Salon and Barber
venues.short: Hair, nails, barber shaves and teeth whitening.
venues.long: Hair styling, keratin treatments, barber shaves, manicures, pedicures and teeth whitening, next to the Lotus Spa. Formal-night updos and blowouts book up early.

venues.title: Thermal Suite
venues.short: A classic thermal suite with heated tile beds and aroma steam rooms.
venues.long: Sapphire Princess has no Enclave. Its Lotus Spa Thermal Suite on Deck 15 has heated tile beds and aroma steam rooms, and the locker rooms have complimentary dry saunas and steam rooms.

venues.title: The Sanctuary
venues.short: An adults-only (18+) open-air retreat with teak loungers and steward service.
venues.long: A tranquil adults-only retreat with thick-cushioned teak loungers, chilled face towels, misters and light healthy fare, with outdoor massage cabanas. Half a day is $20 and a full day $40. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Theater
venues.short: The classic two-tier theatre for production revues, concerts and variety.
venues.long: Warm wood and plush seating. Evening revues (Bravo, Encore, Magic to Do or Born to Dance) with the Princess Singers, Dancers and showband, and afternoon lectures and classical recitals.
accessibility: Wheelchair spaces at the back and sides; ask an usher

venues.title: Club Fusion
venues.short: The aft lounge for Pop Star karaoke, line dancing, bingo and party bands.
venues.long: Dozens of synchronised screens, theatrical lighting and a wooden dance floor at the end of the Promenade Deck: Princess Pop Star, dance lessons, bingo and live bands.

venues.title: Explorers Lounge
venues.short: A midship lounge for trivia, auctions, comedy and cover bands.
venues.long: Safari, Egyptian and Silk Road decor with its own bar and stage. Morning trivia and port talks, then audience game shows, guest comedians and live rock and pop.

venues.title: Wheelhouse live music
venues.short: Ballroom, swing and blues bands in the clubby nautical lounge.
venues.long: Dark mahogany and a hardwood dance floor: quiet cards by day, then live ballroom, swing and classic blues in the evening. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Skywalkers Nightclub
venues.short: The glass lounge high over the stern: a quiet viewpoint by day and a nightclub after 10 pm.
venues.long: Reached by a glass-walled moving walkway, with 270-degree ocean views from 150 feet up. Quiet tiered seating by day, especially for scenic cruising; a resident DJ and a neon dance floor after 10 pm.

venues.title: The Piazza
venues.short: The three-deck atrium, the heart of the ship, for quartets, lessons and the Champagne Waterfall.
venues.long: Around the International Café and Vines Wine Bar: string quartets, ballroom lessons, street-style variety acts and the Captain’s Welcome Champagne Waterfall.
accessibility: Each level has a lift to the others

venues.title: Crooners
venues.short: The piano martini bar for Rat Pack requests.
venues.long: A piano bar beside the Piazza with Rat Pack classics and martini requests. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Neptune’s Reef Pool and Movies Under the Stars
venues.short: The main lido pool with a giant screen, bandstand and deck parties.
venues.long: Tiered sun decks and hot tubs around the main pool, for sailaway parties, live bands and games by day and an open-air cinema with blankets and popcorn at night. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Casino
venues.short: Slots and table games, closed in port.
venues.long: A classic midship casino with 150 to 180 slots, live table pits and automated Texas Hold’em tables. Slot machines, live table games and electronic roulette, paid with your Medallion through ticket-in, ticket-out. It is run in international waters, so it is closed in port and opens 30 to 45 minutes after the ship sails.

venues.title: Lotus Spa Fitness Center
venues.short: A bow-facing gym with 35 cardio machines and 17 weight stations.
venues.long: Next to the Lotus Spa at the front of the Sun Deck, with forward ocean views, Precor treadmills, ellipticals, bikes, a rowing machine, cable machines and free weights. The floor is open 24 hours, but treadmills may be roped off from 8 pm to 8 am on some sailings because staterooms are directly below. The staffed desk is open from 7 am to 7:30 pm.

venues.title: Spin and Aerobics Studio
venues.short: Twelve indoor cycling bikes and floor space for mat classes.
venues.long: Beside the gym, for CycleBar, Pilates, yoga and boot camp classes during staffed hours.

venues.title: Promenade and Sun Deck Tracks
venues.short: A wrap-around teak promenade and an upper-deck loop for walking and jogging.
venues.long: Deck 7 has the classic wrap-around promenade, where 2.5 laps make a mile. Because the cabins are directly below, jogging is only allowed from 8 am to 8 pm, while quiet walking is welcome day and night. A second loop on the upper deck is open in daylight.

venues.title: Center Court and Lawn Court
venues.short: Upper-deck courts for basketball, paddle tennis, golf putting and croquet.
venues.long: Center Court is a netted multi-sport arena for basketball, soccer and paddle tennis. The Lawn Court nearby on Deck 17 is synthetic grass for golf putting and lawn games. Closed overnight.

venues.title: Lotus Spa Lap Pool
venues.short: An adults-only resistance pool with a swim-against-the-current jet.
venues.long: Just outside the fitness centre, opening at 6 am for early swimmers. An adjustable current lets you swim continuous freestyle laps without turning. Closed overnight for maintenance.

venues.title: Calypso Cove
venues.short: The shipboard general store: logo apparel, destination gifts, snacks and duty-free liquor.
venues.long: Steps from the Princess Theater and the Atrium. Destination souvenirs depend on the itinerary, such as Alaskan ulu knives, glacier apparel or Japanese keepsakes, with duty-free spirits and travel necessities.

venues.title: Essence
venues.short: Duty-free designer perfumes, colognes and skincare.
venues.long: Travel-exclusive fragrance sets and cosmetics from Lancôme, Clinique, Chanel and Estée Lauder.

venues.title: Facets
venues.short: Fine jewelry and luxury watches, specialising in Effy and Swiss brands.
venues.long: Along the Promenade walkway, with diamond unveilings, tanzanite showcases and watch consultations.

venues.title: Meridian Bay
venues.short: Fashion jewelry, Swarovski crystals, watches and designer handbags.
venues.long: A popular spot on evening promenades, with Fossil, Citizen and Bulova watches, Brighton accessories and sparkling evening wear.

venues.title: Limelight Boutique
venues.short: Destination clothing, formal accessories and resort fashion.
venues.long: Casual wear for men and women, formal-night ties and shawls, and outdoor gear matched to the Pacific, Alaska or South America.

venues.title: Princess Fine Arts and Photo Gallery
venues.short: A walk-through art gallery and photo desk beside Explorers Lounge and the Wheelhouse Bar.
venues.long: The displays stay open all day and night; the desk is staffed 9 am to 10 pm at sea and from 5 pm after a port.

venues.title: Piazza Pop-Up Tables
venues.short: Flash sales, the Inch of Gold chain bar and visiting artisans on the Piazza floor.
venues.long: $10 to $20 deals on watches, pashminas, jewelry and scarves, the Inch of Gold chain bar, and on some itineraries a visiting local artisan. Folding tables set up for the day. They follow the shops’ rules, so they are closed alongside and open after the ship sails.

venues.title: Neptune’s Pool Pop-Up Market
venues.short: Sunglasses, hats and cover-ups by the pool.
venues.long: An outdoor market set up on sea days, and for a short while after sailaway, weather permitting.

venues.title: Library and Card Room
venues.short: A quiet room of books, cards, mahjong sets and board games.
venues.long: A calm room for bridge, mahjong, cribbage, Scrabble, chess and Catan, with a shelf of books to borrow. The tables are unstaffed and open all day; on sea days a bridge director and the cruise staff host lessons and meet-ups here, and the Wheelhouse Bar takes the overflow.

venues.title: Princess Theater Daytime Talks
venues.short: Discovery at SEA lectures, port talks and the captain’s question-and-answer panel.
venues.long: The main theater by day: Discovery at SEA talks by naturalists, historians and marine biologists, port and shopping presentations, the captain’s panel and the disembarkation talk. Talks are replayed on the stateroom TV.

venues.title: Lido Activity Corner
venues.short: Hands-on crafts, art and music lessons with supplies provided.
venues.long: Staff hand out the supplies for origami, paper flowers, watercolor postcards and, on Pacific voyages, ribbon leis. Ukuleles are loaned for the lessons, and choir rehearsals build to a last-day showcase. Supplies are limited, so come early.

venues.title: Hearts & Minds Chapel and Meeting Rooms
venues.short: Faith services, fellowship and hosted meet-ups for shared interests.
venues.long: A quiet chapel and meeting rooms for interdenominational devotionals, Catholic Mass when a priest is aboard, interfaith reflection and the Shabbat service. The same rooms host the solo travellers, veterans, LGBTQ+ and Friends of Bill W. gatherings. All are welcome and nothing is charged.

venues.title: Camp Discovery Youth Centre
venues.short: Supervised play, science and movie nights for ages 3 to 12.
venues.long: Three age groups: The Treehouse (ages 3 to 7), The Lodge (8 to 12) and The Beach House (13 to 17). Counselors run Discovery at SEA science, scavenger hunts and games, and port-day supervised play for children whose parents are ashore. Register at the centre on embarkation day or in the app.

venues.title: The Beach House Teen Centre
venues.short: A hangout for ages 13 to 17 with game tournaments and scavenger hunts.
venues.long: Video game tournaments, hunts around the ship and a late-evening music night for teens. The Beach House is part of Camp Discovery, so the same registration applies.

venues.title: Open Decks and Viewing Areas
venues.short: The bow, promenade and upper decks for harbor arrivals, scenic cruising and stargazing.
venues.long: The forward observation decks, Promenade Deck 7 and the Sun Deck, where guests gather for harbor pilot and docking, Alaska, fjord or canal commentary and Discovery at SEA stargazing. Weather permitting; dress warmly.

venues.title: OceanFront Tech Desk
venues.short: Help with MedallionNet Wi-Fi, the Princess app, boarding passes and your Medallion.
venues.long: The staffed tech desk sets up MedallionNet Wi-Fi, helps with the Princess app and photos, prints airline boarding passes, and on the last day helps with Medallion keepsakes and folio questions. Opening hours follow the day: the desk reopens after sailaway on port days.
